notes.title: Participation in the Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC)
notes.content: [h2]Doomed Otaku is participating in BIC 2025![/h2][p]The Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC) is an international indie game event held every year in Busan. Doomed Otaku has qualified to participate and will be showcasing our game there.[/p][p][/p][h3]Dates ｜ August 15 - 17[/h3][h3]Venue ｜ Busan BEXCO Exhibition Center 1, Hall 1[/h3][h3]Booth ｜ C053[/h3][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/9d77e887ac7c521ad442cad6758dda9bf556f7f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/3d494b08838840642d57bae0447dc1c7933b7fd2.png"][/img][/carousel][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Doomed Patch Notes V0.4.12
notes.content: [h3]Main Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Added English demo[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Japanese demo[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added judge content[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a note entry after events[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Other Updates[/h3][list][*][p]The "Load Game" menu is now grayed out when there is no saved data[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where other characters' affection levels were displayed incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]The first bus stop event no longer occurs after 6 p.m[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sparkling effect to the perfume part of the intro[/p][/*][*][p]Event images now have borders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where the nickname "Dollstar Jinda" was not visible[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/cd1e422cdb32ab80d08334259976dac30f4cffbb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update is for the demo version of Doomed Otaku[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 2025 PlayXpo Participation
notes.content:
[h2]Doomed Otaku is Participating in the 2025 PlayXpo!![/h2]

The PlayXpo event will be held at KINTEX in Ilsan from May 22nd to 25th, and admission is free with pre-registration

[list]
[*]PlayXpo: [b]KINTEX Ilsan / May 22nd~25th[/b]
[*]Doomed Otaku Booth: [b]G71 (HALL 5A) / May 23rd~24th[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/81486cfc8113d79f3eb577884457d4e7ccb319ab.png[/img]

We've prepared a variety of new merchandise, so please come and visit us!

notes.title: Doomed Otaku - Steam Demo Now Available
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/

Hello! We are KiwiSaurus, the development team behind Doomed Otaku.
The new demo(v.0.3.6) is now available on Steam!
If you enjoyed it, please consider adding it to your wishlist and leaving a comment.
Doomed Otaku demo is currently available only in Korean, but an English translation will be added in the future.

Here are the updated contents.

[h3] ※Update Details※ [/h3]
[list]
[b][*]Added Day 2 (Reality) event
[*]Holding the Z key now allows script skipping
[*]Save/Load feature added
[*]Date selection available in save slots
[*]bug fixes[/b]
[/list]
[Bug reports] [url=https://discord.com/invite/dmqfTkKC9Q]discord[/url]
[contact] kiwisaurus1130@gmail.com



Doomed Otaku will be featured at the Indie Live Expo today, April 13th, at 6 PM! We appreciate your interest.
